signal_features — ONED signal op

• Data kinds: signal → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.signal_features(x, rate=1.0) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import dsp; dsp.signal_features(x, rate=1.0), registry से लेना हो तो ops1d.get("signal_features"))

उपयोग

anomaly detection के लिए संक्षिप्त acoustic/vibration feature vector: rms, peak, crest_factor, zcr, spectral_centroid (Hz), peak_freq (Hz), bandwidth (Hz)। सभी finite — NaN / Inf sample NaN feature बनाने के बजाय ValueError देता है; खाली signal -> शून्य।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

The three spectral entries are built on spectrum, but every one of them is a *ratio* of magnitudes (argmax, a magnitude-weighted mean, a magnitude-weighted spread), so the raw |rfft| convention documented there cancels out and these numbers are unaffected by it. rms, peak and crest_factor are computed in the time domain and never touch the FFT.
